title: Canonical Epistle (Canon I tip)
author: Gregory Thaumaturgus
blurb: Gregory Thaumaturgus, Epistula Canonica. New English for private study; ANF exists. Tip covers captives eating food set by barbarians and captive women under force.
era_note: Written amid Gothic raids in Pontus under Gallienus. Tip covers Canon I only; Canons II–XI remain.
first_english_note: Prior English exists (ANF); this is a new rendering from locked Greek for Canon I.

text_history.method: English from locked Canones GR tip Canon I; ANF consulted only as sense check
